rulings.decision: Clipboard capture keeps the Linux daemon queue with content-fingerprint dedupe; upstream's per-generation dedupe (repeatedGeneration) is not used because Klipper re-assertions arrive as new daemon events.

OCR keeps prepareOcrLanguages (any installed language, async). Upstream's SHA-256 model verification is not taken: it hashes whole model files synchronously on the main thread and only knows the bundled eng/tur files. cacheMethod 'none' and stale .traineddata removal are taken (removal made async).
Default Linux screenshot folders, output.ownsFile suppression and --hidden login item stay; upstream's watcher error logging is added.
Linux daemon-socket monitor stays; it now calls the new optional ready() callback on connect.
